## Secure storage example
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SecurePrefs(context: Context) {
    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveSessionToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("session_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getSessionToken(): String? = prefs.getString("session_token", null)

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}
```

## 3) ViewModel

### `BankingViewModel.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.viewmodel

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.data.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class BankingUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isLoggedIn: Boolean = false,
    val accounts: List<Account> = emptyList(),
    val transactions: List<Transaction> = emptyList(),
    val errorMessage: String? = null
)

class BankingViewModel(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(BankingUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<BankingUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, errorMessage = null)
            try {
                val success = repository.login(username, password)
                if (success) {
                    val accounts = repository.getAccounts()
                    val transactions = repository.getTransactions()
                    _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isLoggedIn = true,
                        accounts = accounts,
                        transactions = transactions
                    )
                } else {
                    _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        errorMessage = "Invalid credentials"
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    errorMessage = "Something went wrong"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.util

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SessionManager(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_session",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("auth_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? {
        return prefs.getString("auth_token", null)
    }

    fun clearToken() {
        prefs.edit().remove("auth_token").apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    isLoggedIn = true,
                    accounts = accounts,
                    transactions = transactions
                )
            } else {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    loginError = "Invalid credentials"
                )
            }
        }
    }
```

## 9) Auth Interceptor

### `data/remote/interceptor/AuthInterceptor.kt`

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.data.remote.interceptor

import com.yourbank.app.data.local.secure.SecureStorage
import okhttp3.Interceptor
import okhttp3.Response

class AuthInterceptor(
    private val secureStorage: SecureStorage
) : Interceptor {
    override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
        val token = secureStorage.getAccessToken()
        val request = chain.request().newBuilder().apply {
            if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
            }
        }.build()

        return chain.proceed(request)
    }
}
```

## 10) Secure Storage

### `data/local/secure/SecureStorage.kt`

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.data.local.secure

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SecureStorage(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveAccessToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, token).apply()
    }

    fun getAccessToken(): String? = prefs.getString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, null)

    fun saveRefreshToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN, token).apply()
    }

    fun getRefreshToken(): String? = prefs.getString(KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN, null)

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN = "access_token"
        private const val KEY_REFRESH_TOKEN = "refresh_token"
    }
}
```

## 12) Repository Layer

### `data/repository/AuthRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.data.repository

import com.yourbank.app.data.local.secure.SecureStorage
import com.yourbank.app.data.remote.ApiService
import com.yourbank.app.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.yourbank.app.util.ResultState
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val secureStorage: SecureStorage
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): ResultState<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            secureStorage.saveAccessToken(response.accessToken)
            secureStorage.saveRefreshToken(response.refreshToken)
            ResultState.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            ResultState.Error(e.message ?: "Login failed")
        }
    }

    fun logout() {
        secureStorage.clear()
    }
}
```

### `data/repository/BankingRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.data.repository

import com.yourbank.app.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.yourbank.app.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.yourbank.app.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.yourbank.app.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.yourbank.app.data.remote.ApiService
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts() = accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
        list.map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    fun observeTransactions() = transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
        list.map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    suspend fun refreshData() = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val accounts = api.getAccounts().map {
            AccountEntity(it.id, it.name, it.type, it.balance, it.currency)
        }
        val transactions = api.getTransactions().map {
            TransactionEntity(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.date, it.category)
        }
        accountDao.upsertAll(accounts)
        transactionDao.upsertAll(transactions)
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = com.yourbank.app.domain.model.Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)
    private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = com.yourbank.app.domain.model.BankTransaction(id, accountId, title, amount, date, category)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.di

import android.content.Context
import com.yourbank.app.data.local.secure.SecureStorage
import com.yourbank.app.data.remote.ApiService
import com.yourbank.app.data.remote.interceptor.AuthInterceptor
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideSecureStorage(@ApplicationContext context: Context) = SecureStorage(context)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideAuthInterceptor(secureStorage: SecureStorage) = AuthInterceptor(secureStorage)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(authInterceptor: AuthInterceptor): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(authInterceptor)
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.yourbank.app.data.repository.AuthRepository
import com.yourbank.app.util.ResultState
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val success: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            when (val result = authRepository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)) {
                is ResultState.Success -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, success = true)
                is ResultState.Error -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, error = result.message)
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.yourbank.app.ui.screens.home

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.yourbank.app.data.repository.BankingRepository
import com.yourbank.app.domain.model.Account
import com.yourbank.app.util.ResultState
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class HomeUiState(
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val accounts: List<Account> = emptyList(),
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class HomeViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(HomeUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<HomeUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        observeAccounts()
        refresh()
    }

    private fun observeAccounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.observeAccounts().collect { accounts ->
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(accounts = accounts)
            }
        }
    }

    fun refresh() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true)
            try {
                repository.refreshData()
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, error = e.message)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }

        composable(Routes.HOME) {
            HomeScreen(

            )
        }
        composable(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) {
            TransactionsScreen(onBack = { navController.popBackStack() })
        }
    }
```

# 8) Secure token storage

## `TokenStorage.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.secure

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class TokenStorage(context: Context) {
    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_auth",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveAccessToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("access_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getAccessToken(): String? = prefs.getString("access_token", null)

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import java.time.Instant
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    suspend fun refreshDashboard() {
        val accounts = apiService.getAccounts().map {
            AccountEntity(it.id, it.name, it.type, it.balance, it.currency)
        }
        val transactions = apiService.getTransactions().map {
            TransactionEntity(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.currency, it.timestamp)
        }

        accountDao.clearAll()
        transactionDao.clearAll()
        accountDao.insertAll(accounts)
        transactionDao.insertAll(transactions)
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)

    private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(
        id = id,
        accountId = accountId,
        title = title,
        amount = amount,
        currency = currency,
        timestamp = Instant.parse(timestamp)
    )
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope

import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val success: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            try {
                authRepository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false, success = true)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = e.message ?: "Login failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    data object Dashboard : Routes("dashboard")

fun NavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.Login.route
    ) {
        composable(Routes.Login.route) {
            val vm: LoginViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            val state = vm.uiState.collectAsState().value

            LoginScreen(

                        popUpTo(Routes.Login.route) { inclusive = true }

            val vm: DashboardViewModel = hiltViewModel()
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransferRequestDto
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.TransactionType
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.UserSession
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService
) : BankingRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): UserSession {
        val response = apiService.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
        return UserSession(
            token = response.token,
            userId = response.userId,
            fullName = response.fullName
        )
    }

    override suspend fun getAccounts(): List<Account> {
        return apiService.getAccounts().map {
            Account(
                id = it.id,
                accountNumber = it.accountNumber,
                accountType = it.accountType,
                balance = it.balance,
                currency = it.currency
            )
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return apiService.getTransactions(accountId).map {
            Transaction(
                id = it.id,
                title = it.title,
                description = it.description,
                amount = it.amount,
                date = it.date,
                type = if (it.type.uppercase() == "CREDIT") TransactionType.CREDIT else TransactionType.DEBIT
            )
        }
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(
        fromAccountId: String,
        toAccountNumber: String,
        amount: Double,
        note: String?
    ): Boolean {
        val response = apiService.transfer(
            TransferRequestDto(fromAccountId, toAccountNumber, amount, note)
        )
        return response.success
    }
}
```

```kotlin
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {

        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides

    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit {
        return Retrofit.Builder()

            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService {
        return retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            try {
                repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
                onSuccess()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Login failed")
            } finally {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.home

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class HomeUiState(
    val accounts: List<Account> = emptyList(),
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class HomeViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(HomeUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<HomeUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        loadAccounts()
    }

    private fun loadAccounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true)
            try {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(accounts = repository.getAccounts())
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Unable to load accounts")

                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
```

```kotlin
@Composable
fun NavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.SPLASH
    ) {
        composable(Routes.SPLASH) {
            SplashScreen(

            LoginScreen(
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.HOME) {
            HomeScreen()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.UserDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.UserEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.User
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val userDao: UserDao
) : AuthRepository {

    override suspend fun login(email: String, password: String): Result<User> {
        return try {
            val response = apiService.login(LoginRequest(email, password))
            val user = User(
                id = response.userId,
                fullName = response.fullName,
                email = response.email
            )
            userDao.insert(UserEntity(user.id, user.fullName, user.email))
            Result.success(user)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    override suspend fun logout() {
        userDao.clear()
    }

    override suspend fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return userDao.observeUser().first() != null
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.auth

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.AuthRepository
import com.example.bankapp.util.ResultState
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class AuthViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _loginState = MutableStateFlow<ResultState<Unit>>(ResultState.Idle)
    val loginState: StateFlow<ResultState<Unit>> = _loginState

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _loginState.value = ResultState.Loading
            val result = authRepository.login(email, password)
            _loginState.value = result.fold(
                onSuccess = { ResultState.Success(Unit) },
                onFailure = { ResultState.Error(it.message ?: "Login failed") }
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.jakewharton.retrofit2.converter.kotlinx.serialization.asConverterFactory
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideJson(): Json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        isLenient = true
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(
        okHttpClient: OkHttpClient,
        json: Json
    ): Retrofit {
        val contentType = "application/json".toMediaType()
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory(json.asConverterFactory(contentType))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
                    amount = it.amount,
                    date = it.date,
                    isDebit = it.isDebit
```

```kotlin
@HiltViewModel
class DashboardViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _accounts = MutableStateFlow<UiState<List<Account>>>(UiState.Loading)
    val accounts: StateFlow<UiState<List<Account>>> = _accounts.asStateFlow()

    val transactions: StateFlow<List<Transaction>> =
        repository.getTransactions()
            .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000), emptyList())

    init {
        loadData()
    }

    private fun loadData() {
        _accounts.value = UiState.Success(repository.getAccounts())
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.seedTransactions()
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        when (accountsState) {
            is UiState.Loading -> CircularProgressIndicator()
            is UiState.Error -> Text("Failed to load accounts")
            is UiState.Success -> {

                accounts.forEach { account ->

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

        LazyColumn {
            items(transactions) { transaction ->
                TransactionRow(transaction)
            }
        }
    }
}

    Card(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp)) {

                color = if (transaction.isDebit) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            )
        }
    }
```

## 8) Repository

### `BankingRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): String {
        return api.login(LoginRequest(username, password)).token
    }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts().map { it.toEntity() }
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote)
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions() {
        val remote = api.getTransactions().map { it.toEntity() }
        transactionDao.upsertAll(remote)
    }

    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }
}
```

```kotlin
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao

import dagger.Module

import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object AppModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext context: Context): AppDatabase =
        Room.databaseBuilder(context, AppDatabase::class.java, "bank.db").build()

    @Provides
    fun provideAccountDao(db: AppDatabase): AccountDao = db.accountDao()

    @Provides
    fun provideTransactionDao(db: AppDatabase): TransactionDao = db.transactionDao()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides

    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRepository(
        api: ApiService,
        accountDao: AccountDao,
        transactionDao: TransactionDao
    ): BankingRepository = BankingRepository(api, accountDao, transactionDao)
```

```kotlin
    val token: String? = null,
    val error: String? = null
)

class AuthViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(AuthUiState())
    val state: StateFlow<AuthUiState> = _state

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.value = AuthUiState(loading = true)
            try {
                val token = repository.login(username, password)
                _state.value = AuthUiState(token = token)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _state.value = AuthUiState(error = e.message ?: "Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local.prefs

import android.content.Context

import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "session_prefs")

class SessionManager(private val context: Context) {

    private val tokenKey = stringPreferencesKey("auth_token")

    val token: Flow<String?> = context.dataStore.data.map { prefs ->
        prefs[tokenKey]
    }

    suspend fun saveToken(token: String) {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[tokenKey] = token
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearToken() {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs.remove(tokenKey)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankingRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<String> {
        return try {
            val response = apiService.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            if (response.isSuccessful && response.body() != null) {
                Result.success(response.body()!!.token)
            } else {
                Result.failure(Exception("Login failed"))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    override fun getAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> {
        return accountDao.getAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override fun getTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> {
        return transactionDao.getTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, balance, currency)
    private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, title, amount, date, type)
}
```

```kotlin
import retrofit2.Retrofit

import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideMoshi(): Moshi = Moshi.Builder()
        .add(KotlinJsonAdapterFactory())
        .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(okHttpClient: OkHttpClient, moshi: Moshi): Retrofit {
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create(moshi))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankingRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            val result = repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)

            result.onSuccess {
                onSuccess()
            }.onFailure {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = it.message ?: "Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

# 19) Important Banking App Security Notes

For a real banking app, you should add:

- **TLS only** with certificate pinning
- **Encrypted token storage**
- **Biometric authentication**
- **Root/jailbreak detection**
- **Screenshot blocking**
- **Session timeout**
- **Device binding**
- **Fraud/risk monitoring**
- **Audit logging**

```kotlin
class AuthViewModel(
    private val repository: BankRepository

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AuthUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AuthUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = AuthUiState(isLoading = true)
            val user = repository.login(email, password)
            _uiState.value = if (user != null) {
                AuthUiState(user = user)
            } else {
                AuthUiState(errorMessage = "Invalid email or password")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### `viewmodel/DashboardViewModel.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.viewmodel

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.data.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class DashboardUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val accounts: List<Account> = emptyList(),
    val transactions: List<Transaction> = emptyList(),
    val errorMessage: String? = null
)

class DashboardViewModel(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(DashboardUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<DashboardUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun loadDashboard(userId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(isLoading = true)
            try {
                val accounts = repository.getAccounts(userId)
                val transactions = if (accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                    repository.getTransactions(accounts.first().id)
                } else emptyList()

                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(
                    accounts = accounts,
                    transactions = transactions
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(errorMessage = e.message ?: "Unknown error")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.navigation.NavHostController
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.MockBankRepository
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.DashboardScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.AuthViewModel
import com.example.bankapp.viewmodel.DashboardViewModel

sealed class Screen(val route: String) {
    data object Login : Screen("login")
    data object Dashboard : Screen("dashboard")
}

@Composable
fun NavGraph(
    navController: NavHostController = rememberNavController()
) {
    val repository = remember { MockBankRepository() }
    val authViewModel = remember { AuthViewModel(repository) }
    val dashboardViewModel = remember { DashboardViewModel(repository) }

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Screen.Login.route
    ) {
        composable(Screen.Login.route) {
            LoginScreen(
                authViewModel = authViewModel,
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Screen.Dashboard.route) {
                        popUpTo(Screen.Login.route) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Screen.Dashboard.route) {
            LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
                dashboardViewModel.loadDashboard("user_1")
            }
            DashboardScreen(
                dashboardViewModel = dashboardViewModel
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.util

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SessionManager(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_session",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveAccessToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, token).apply()
    }

    fun getAccessToken(): String? = prefs.getString(KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN, null)

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val KEY_ACCESS_TOKEN = "access_token"
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.clearAll()
        accountDao.insertAll(remote.map {
            AccountEntity(it.id, it.name, it.balance, it.currency)
        })
    }

    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { Account(it.id, it.name, it.balance, it.currency) }
        }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.clearAll()
        transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map {
            TransactionEntity(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.timestamp)
        })
    }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list ->
            list.map { Transaction(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.timestamp) }
        }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.util.SessionManager
import android.content.Context
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.gson.GsonConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(sessionManager: SessionManager): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }

        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor { chain ->
                val token = sessionManager.getAccessToken()
                val request = chain.request().newBuilder().apply {
                    if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
                    }
                }.build()
                chain.proceed(request)
            }
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(GsonConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideSessionManager(@ApplicationContext context: Context): SessionManager =
        SessionManager(context)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.AuthRepository
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            try {
                authRepository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
                onSuccess()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    loading = false,
                    error = "Login failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 11) Repository implementation

### `data/repository/BankingRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankingapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankingapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankingapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankingapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankingapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankingapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankingapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankingapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankingapp.domain.repository.BankingRepository
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankingRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
        return response.token.isNotBlank()
    }

    override suspend fun getAccounts(): List<Account> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getAccounts()
            accountDao.clear()
            accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            remote.map { it.toDomain() }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            accountDao.getAll().map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(): List<Transaction> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getTransactions()
            transactionDao.clear()
            transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            remote.map { it.toDomain() }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            transactionDao.getAll().map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        val result = api.transfer(
            mapOf(
                "toAccount" to toAccount,
                "amount" to amount
            )
        )
        return result["success"] == true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.ui.viewmodel

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope

import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val success: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            try {
                val ok = loginUseCase(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, success = ok)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    loading = false,
                    error = "Login failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.core.security

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "secure_prefs")

@Singleton
class TokenManager @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {
    private val TOKEN_KEY = stringPreferencesKey("auth_token")

    suspend fun saveToken(token: String) {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[TOKEN_KEY] = token
        }
    }

    suspend fun getToken(): String? {
        val prefs = context.dataStore.data.first()
        return prefs[TOKEN_KEY]
    }

    suspend fun clearToken() {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs.remove(TOKEN_KEY)
        }
    }
}
```

### `AuthInterceptor.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.core.network

import com.example.bankapp.core.security.TokenManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import okhttp3.Interceptor
import okhttp3.Response
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthInterceptor @Inject constructor(
    private val tokenManager: TokenManager
) : Interceptor {
    override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
        val token = runBlocking { tokenManager.getToken() }
        val request = chain.request().newBuilder().apply {
            if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
            }
        }.build()
        return chain.proceed(request)
    }
}
```

## 9) Repository implementation

### `BankingRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.core.network.NetworkResult
import com.example.bankapp.core.security.TokenManager
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankingApi
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankingRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankingApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao,
    private val tokenManager: TokenManager
) : BankingRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): NetworkResult<Unit> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            tokenManager.saveToken(response.token)
            NetworkResult.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            NetworkResult.Error(e.message ?: "Login failed")
        }
    }

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override suspend fun refreshAccounts(): NetworkResult<Unit> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getAccounts()
            accountDao.clearAll()
            accountDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            NetworkResult.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            NetworkResult.Error(e.message ?: "Failed to load accounts")
        }
    }

    override suspend fun refreshTransactions(): NetworkResult<Unit> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getTransactions()
            transactionDao.clearAll()
            transactionDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            NetworkResult.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            NetworkResult.Error(e.message ?: "Failed to load transactions")
        }
    }
}

private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, balance, currency)
private fun Account.toEntity() = AccountEntity(id, name, balance, currency)

private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, accountId, title, amount, timestamp)
private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() =
    TransactionEntity(id, accountId, title, amount, timestamp)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() =
    AccountEntity(id, name, balance, currency)
```

```kotlin
data class AuthUiState(
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val isLoggedIn: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class AuthViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AuthUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AuthUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = AuthUiState(isLoading = true)
            when (val result = loginUseCase(username, password)) {
                is NetworkResult.Success -> _uiState.value = AuthUiState(isLoggedIn = true)
                is NetworkResult.Error -> _uiState.value = AuthUiState(error = result.message)
                NetworkResult.Loading -> Unit
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.kotlinx.serialization.asConverterFactory
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object AppModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext context: Context): AppDatabase =
        Room.databaseBuilder(context, AppDatabase::class.java, "bank.db").build()

    @Provides fun provideAccountDao(db: AppDatabase): AccountDao = db.accountDao()
    @Provides fun provideTransactionDao(db: AppDatabase): TransactionDao = db.transactionDao()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(authInterceptor: AuthInterceptor): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(authInterceptor)
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit {
        val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(json.asConverterFactory("application/json".toMediaType()))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankingApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankingApi =
        retrofit.create(BankingApi::class.java)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRepository(
        api: BankingApi,
        accountDao: AccountDao,
        transactionDao: TransactionDao,
        tokenManager: TokenManager
    ): BankingRepository = BankingRepositoryImpl(api, accountDao, transactionDao, tokenManager)
```

### `data/repository/BankingRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankingApi
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankingApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions() {
        val remote = api.getTransactions()
        transactionDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.AuthRepository
import com.example.bankapp.util.ResultState
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val token: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            when (val result = authRepository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)) {
                is ResultState.Success -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    token = result.data
                )
                is ResultState.Error -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = result.message
                )
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 19) Security note for banking apps

For a real banking app, do not store tokens in plain `SharedPreferences`. Use:

- **EncryptedSharedPreferences**
- or **Jetpack DataStore + encryption strategy**
- plus **biometric auth**
- plus **certificate pinning**
- plus **root/jailbreak detection** if required by policy

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.BankDao

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import java.util.UUID
import javax.inject.Inject

class MockBankRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val dao: BankDao
) : BankRepository {

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        dao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map {
                Account(
                    id = it.id,
                    name = it.name,
                    maskedNumber = it.maskedNumber,
                    balance = it.balance,
                    currency = it.currency
                )
            }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        dao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map {
                Transaction(
                    id = it.id,
                    title = it.title,
                    subtitle = it.subtitle,
                    amount = it.amount,
                    timestamp = it.timestamp,
                    type = TransactionType.valueOf(it.type)
                )
            }
        }

    override suspend fun login(email: String, password: String): Result<User> {
        return if (email.isNotBlank() && password.length >= 4) {
            Result.success(
                User(
                    id = "user-1",
                    fullName = "Alex Johnson",
                    email = email
                )
            )
        } else {
            Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Invalid credentials"))
        }
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(fromAccountId: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Result<Unit> {
        val accounts = dao.observeAccounts() // not directly usable for suspend read
        return Result.success(Unit)
    }

    override suspend fun seedInitialData() {
        val accounts = listOf(
            AccountEntity("acc-1", "Checking", "**** 1234", 2450.75, "USD"),
            AccountEntity("acc-2", "Savings", "**** 5678", 10250.00, "USD")
        )

        val txs = listOf(
            TransactionEntity(
                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                title = "Salary",
                subtitle = "ACME Corp",
                amount = 3200.00,
                timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis() - 86400000L,
                type = "CREDIT"

            TransactionEntity(

                title = "Groceries",
                subtitle = "Whole Foods",
                amount = -86.42,
                timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis() - 3600000L,
                type = "DEBIT"
            )
        )

        dao.insertAccounts(accounts)
        dao.insertTransactions(txs)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.BankRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onEmailChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(email = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            val result = repository.login(_uiState.value.email, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false)
            result.onSuccess { onSuccess() }
                .onFailure { _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = it.message) }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
@Composable
fun BankNavGraph(navController: NavHostController) {
    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                onTransferClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSFER) }
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.TRANSFER) {
            TransferScreen(onDone = { navController.popBackStack() })
        }
    }
}
```

# 9) Secure session manager

## `SecureSessionManager.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.UserSession

class SecureSessionManager(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_session",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveSession(session: UserSession) {
        prefs.edit()
            .putString("accessToken", session.accessToken)
            .putString("refreshToken", session.refreshToken)
            .putString("userId", session.userId)
            .apply()
    }

    fun getSession(): UserSession? {
        val accessToken = prefs.getString("accessToken", null) ?: return null
        val refreshToken = prefs.getString("refreshToken", null) ?: return null
        val userId = prefs.getString("userId", null) ?: return null
        return UserSession(accessToken, refreshToken, userId)
    }

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.SecureSessionManager

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest

import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val sessionManager: SecureSessionManager
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Resource<UserSession> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            val session = UserSession(response.accessToken, response.refreshToken, response.userId)
            sessionManager.saveSession(session)
            Resource.Success(session)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error("Login failed: ${e.message ?: "Unknown error"}")
        }
    }

    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean = sessionManager.getSession() != null

    fun logout() = sessionManager.clear()
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts(): Resource<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val remote = api.getAccounts()
            accountDao.clear()
            accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            Resource.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error("Failed to load accounts: ${e.message ?: "Unknown error"}")
        }
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String): Resource<Unit> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
            transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            Resource.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error("Failed to load transactions: ${e.message ?: "Unknown error"}")
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideSecureSessionManager(@ApplicationContext context: Context): SecureSessionManager =
        SecureSessionManager(context)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(sessionManager: SecureSessionManager): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {

        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(sessionManager))
            .addInterceptor(logging)

    @Provides

    fun provideRetrofit(okHttpClient: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankApi =
        retrofit.create(BankApi::class.java)
```

# 13) Auth interceptor

## `AuthInterceptor.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.remote

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.SecureSessionManager
import okhttp3.Interceptor
import okhttp3.Response

class AuthInterceptor(
    private val sessionManager: SecureSessionManager
) : Interceptor {
    override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
        val original = chain.request()
        val session = sessionManager.getSession()

        val request = if (session != null) {
            original.newBuilder()
                .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer ${session.accessToken}")
                .build()
        } else {
            original
        }

        return chain.proceed(request)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val loggedIn: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            when (val result = authRepository.login(
                _uiState.value.username,
                _uiState.value.password
            )) {
                is Resource.Success -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, loggedIn = true)
                is Resource.Error -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, error = result.message)
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
@Composable
fun NavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(navController = navController, startDestination = Routes.LOGIN) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            val vm: LoginViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            val state = vm.uiState.collectAsState().value

            LoginScreen(
                uiState = state,
                onUsernameChange = vm::onUsernameChange,
                onPasswordChange = vm::onPasswordChange,

            )

            if (state.loggedIn) {
                navController.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                    popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                }

        composable(Routes.HOME) {
            val vm: HomeViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            val accounts = vm.accounts.collectAsState().value

            HomeScreen(
                accounts = accounts,
                onRefresh = vm::refresh
```

- **Compliance**
  - PCI DSS considerations
  - GDPR/CCPA

  - proper API contracts

- **UX**
  - loading/skeleton states
