import math
import random
import pygame

# ----------------------------
# Utility functions
# ----------------------------

def clamp(x, a, b):
    return max(a, min(b, x))

def vec2(x=0.0, y=0.0):
    return [float(x), float(y)]

def vadd(a, b):
    return [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1]]

def vsub(a, b):
    return [a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]]

def vmul(a, s):
    return [a[0] * s, a[1] * s]

def vdot(a, b):
    return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]

def vlen(a):
    return math.sqrt(vdot(a, a))

def vnormalize(a):
    l = vlen(a)
    if l == 0:
        return [0.0, 0.0]
    return [a[0] / l, a[1] / l]

def vperp(a):
    return [-a[1], a[0]]

def cross2(a, b):
    # scalar cross product in 2D
    return a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0]

def cross_sv(s, v):
    # scalar x vector
    return [-s * v[1], s * v[0]]

# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

class RigidBody:
    def __init__(self, x, y, radius, mass, color=(255, 255, 255), is_static=False):
        self.pos = vec2(x, y)
        self.vel = vec2(0, 0)
        self.angle = 0.0
        self.ang_vel = 0.0

        self.radius = radius
        self.color = color
        self.is_static = is_static

        if is_static or mass <= 0:
            self.mass = 0.0
            self.inv_mass = 0.0
            self.inertia = 0.0
            self.inv_inertia = 0.0
        else:
            self.mass = mass
            self.inv_mass = 1.0 / mass
            # solid disk inertia
            self.inertia = 0.5 * mass * radius * radius
            self.inv_inertia = 1.0 / self.inertia

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse, contact_vec):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.vel[0] += impulse[0] * self.inv_mass
        self.vel[1] += impulse[1] * self.inv_mass
        self.ang_vel += self.inv_inertia * cross2(contact_vec, impulse)

    def integrate(self, dt, gravity):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.vel[0] += gravity[0] * dt
        self.vel[1] += gravity[1] * dt
        self.pos[0] += self.vel[0] * dt
        self.pos[1] += self.vel[1] * dt
        self.angle += self.ang_vel * dt

# ----------------------------
# Collision resolution
# ----------------------------

def resolve_circle_circle(a, b, restitution=0.4, friction=0.2):
    delta = vsub(b.pos, a.pos)
    dist = vlen(delta)
    min_dist = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist == 0:
        # Avoid division by zero
        normal = [1.0, 0.0]
        penetration = min_dist
    else:
        if dist >= min_dist:
            return
        normal = [delta[0] / dist, delta[1] / dist]
        penetration = min_dist - dist

    # Positional correction (split by inverse mass)
    total_inv_mass = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
    if total_inv_mass > 0:
        correction = vmul(normal, penetration / total_inv_mass * 0.8)
        if a.inv_mass > 0:
            a.pos[0] -= correction[0] * a.inv_mass
            a.pos[1] -= correction[1] * a.inv_mass
        if b.inv_mass > 0:
            b.pos[0] += correction[0] * b.inv_mass
            b.pos[1] += correction[1] * b.inv_mass

    # Contact points relative to centers
    ra = vmul(normal, a.radius)
    rb = vmul(normal, -b.radius)

    # Relative velocity at contact
    va = vadd(a.vel, cross_sv(a.ang_vel, ra))
    vb = vadd(b.vel, cross_sv(b.ang_vel, rb))
    rv = vsub(vb, va)

    vel_along_normal = vdot(rv, normal)
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    ra_cn = cross2(ra, normal)
    rb_cn = cross2(rb, normal)

    inv_mass_sum = (
        a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass +
        (ra_cn * ra_cn) * a.inv_inertia +
        (rb_cn * rb_cn) * b.inv_inertia
    )

    j = -(1.0 + restitution) * vel_along_normal
    j /= inv_mass_sum if inv_mass_sum > 0 else 1.0

    impulse = vmul(normal, j)
    a.apply_impulse(vmul(impulse, -1), ra)
    b.apply_impulse(impulse, rb)

    # Friction
    va = vadd(a.vel, cross_sv(a.ang_vel, ra))
    vb = vadd(b.vel, cross_sv(b.ang_vel, rb))
    rv = vsub(vb, va)

    tangent = vsub(rv, vmul(normal, vdot(rv, normal)))
    tangent = vnormalize(tangent)

    jt = -vdot(rv, tangent)
    jt /= inv_mass_sum if inv_mass_sum > 0 else 1.0

    mu = friction
    friction_impulse = [0.0, 0.0]
    if abs(jt) < j * mu:
        friction_impulse = vmul(tangent, jt)
    else:
        friction_impulse = vmul(tangent, -j * mu)

    a.apply_impulse(vmul(friction_impulse, -1), ra)
    b.apply_impulse(friction_impulse, rb)

def resolve_circle_walls(body, width, height, restitution=0.5, friction=0.2):
    if body.inv_mass == 0:
        return

    # Left wall
    if body.pos[0] - body.radius < 0:
        body.pos[0] = body.radius
        if body.vel[0] < 0:
            body.vel[0] *= -restitution
            body.vel[1] *= (1.0 - friction)

    # Right wall
    if body.pos[0] + body.radius > width:
        body.pos[0] = width - body.radius
        if body.vel[0] > 0:
            body.vel[0] *= -restitution
            body.vel[1] *= (1.0 - friction)

    # Top wall
    if body.pos[1] - body.radius < 0:
        body.pos[1] = body.radius
        if body.vel[1] < 0:
            body.vel[1] *= -restitution
            body.vel[0] *= (1.0 - friction)

    # Bottom wall
    if body.pos[1] + body.radius > height:
        body.pos[1] = height - body.radius
        if body.vel[1] > 0:
            body.vel[1] *= -restitution
            body.vel[0] *= (1.0 - friction)

# ----------------------------
# Simulation setup
# ----------------------------

def spawn_bodies():
    bodies = []
    colors = [
        (255, 80, 80),
        (80, 255, 120),
        (80, 160, 255),
        (255, 220, 80),
        (200, 80, 255),
    ]

    for i in range(12):
        r = random.randint(12, 28)
        x = random.randint(100, 700)
        y = random.randint(50, 300)
        m = r * 0.8
        b = RigidBody(x, y, r, m, random.choice(colors))
        b.vel = vec2(random.uniform(-120, 120), random.uniform(-30, 30))
        b.ang_vel = random.uniform(-4, 4)
        bodies.append(b)

    # Static floor-like body not needed because walls are handled separately
    return bodies

# ----------------------------
# Main loop with fixed timestep
# ----------------------------

def main():
    pygame.init()
    width, height = 900, 600
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Real-Time Rigid Body Physics Simulation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 18)

    bodies = spawn_bodies()

    gravity = vec2(0, 500)  # pixels/s^2
    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0  # simulation step
    accumulator = 0.0
    max_substeps = 8

    running = True
    while running:
        frame_dt = clock.tick(60) / 1000.0
        frame_dt = min(frame_dt, 0.05)  # clamp to avoid spiral of death
        accumulator += frame_dt

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
                if event.key == pygame.K_r:
                    bodies = spawn_bodies()
                elif event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                    # add a new body at mouse position
                    mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
                    r = random.randint(14, 26)
                    b = RigidBody(mx, my, r, r * 0.8, (255, 180, 80))
                    b.vel = vec2(random.uniform(-150, 150), random.uniform(-100, 0))
                    bodies.append(b)

        substeps = 0
        while accumulator >= fixed_dt and substeps < max_substeps:
            # Integrate
            for body in bodies:
                body.integrate(fixed_dt, gravity)
                resolve_circle_walls(body, width, height)

            # Pairwise collisions
            n = len(bodies)
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    resolve_circle_circle(bodies[i], bodies[j], restitution=0.4, friction=0.15)

            accumulator -= fixed_dt
            substeps += 1

        # Render
        screen.fill((18, 18, 24))

        # Draw bodies
        for body in bodies:
            x, y = int(body.pos[0]), int(body.pos[1])
            pygame.draw.circle(screen, body.color, (x, y), int(body.radius))
            # orientation marker
            hx = x + int(math.cos(body.angle) * body.radius)
            hy = y + int(math.sin(body.angle) * body.radius)
            pygame.draw.line(screen, (255, 255, 255), (x, y), (hx, hy), 2)

        # HUD
        info = [
            "Fixed timestep physics",
            "R: reset   SPACE: spawn body",
            f"Bodies: {len(bodies)}",
            f"Substeps: {substeps}"
        ]
        for i, line in enumerate(info):
            surf = font.render(line, True, (220, 220, 220))
            screen.blit(surf, (12, 12 + i * 20))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## How it works

### 1. Fixed timestep
The simulation uses:

- `fixed_dt = 1/120`
- an accumulator for elapsed frame time
- a cap on substeps to prevent the **spiral of death**

### 2. Rigid body model
Each body tracks:

- position
- velocity
- angle
- angular velocity
- mass and inverse mass
- moment of inertia and inverse inertia

### 3. Collision response
Uses impulse-based resolution:

- compute contact normal
- calculate relative velocity
- apply normal impulse for bounce
- apply tangential impulse for friction
- correct penetration to prevent sinking

### 4. Frame-rate constraints
The code limits:

- max frame delta (`0.05`)
- max physics substeps per frame (`8`)

That prevents simulation overload on slow frames.

import math
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

# ----------------------------
# Vector utilities
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Vec3:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar, self.z * scalar)
    def __rmul__(self, scalar: float): return self.__mul__(scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar, self.z / scalar)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z

    def length(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(self.dot(self))

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        if l == 0:
            return Vec3(0, 0, 0)
        return self / l

    def __neg__(self):
        return Vec3(-self.x, -self.y, -self.z)


# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    position: Vec3
    velocity: Vec3
    mass: float
    radius: float
    restitution: float = 0.5
    is_static: bool = False

    def inverse_mass(self) -> float:
        if self.is_static or self.mass <= 0:
            return 0.0
        return 1.0 / self.mass

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse: Vec3):
        if self.is_static:
            return
        self.velocity = self.velocity + impulse * self.inverse_mass()

    def integrate(self, dt: float, gravity: Vec3):
        if self.is_static:
            return
        self.velocity = self.velocity + gravity * dt
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt


# ----------------------------
# Collision resolution
# ----------------------------

def resolve_sphere_sphere(a: RigidBody, b: RigidBody):
    delta = b.position - a.position
    dist = delta.length()
    penetration = a.radius + b.radius - dist

    if penetration <= 0:
        return

    normal = delta.normalized() if dist > 0 else Vec3(1, 0, 0)

    # Positional correction to prevent sinking
    percent = 0.8
    slop = 0.001
    inv_mass_a = a.inverse_mass()
    inv_mass_b = b.inverse_mass()
    total_inv_mass = inv_mass_a + inv_mass_b

    if total_inv_mass > 0:
        correction_mag = max(penetration - slop, 0.0) / total_inv_mass * percent
        correction = normal * correction_mag
        if not a.is_static:
            a.position = a.position - correction * inv_mass_a
        if not b.is_static:
            b.position = b.position + correction * inv_mass_b

    # Relative velocity along normal
    rv = b.velocity - a.velocity
    vel_along_normal = rv.dot(normal)

    # Don't resolve if separating
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    restitution = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)
    j = -(1 + restitution) * vel_along_normal
    j /= total_inv_mass if total_inv_mass > 0 else 1.0

    impulse = normal * j
    a.apply_impulse(-impulse)
    b.apply_impulse(impulse)


def resolve_ground(body: RigidBody, ground_y: float = 0.0):
    # Ground plane at y = ground_y
    bottom = body.position.y - body.radius
    if bottom >= ground_y:
        return

    # Positional correction
    body.position.y = ground_y + body.radius

    # Bounce/frictionless normal impulse
    if body.velocity.y < 0:
        body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.restitution


# ----------------------------
# Physics world
# ----------------------------

class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bodies = []
        self.gravity = Vec3(0, -9.81, 0)

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate(dt, self.gravity)

        # Collisions with ground
        for body in self.bodies:
            resolve_ground(body, ground_y=0.0)

        # Pairwise collisions
        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                resolve_sphere_sphere(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])


# ----------------------------
# Example real-time loop
# ----------------------------

def main():
    world = PhysicsWorld()

    # Create some bodies
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec3(0, 8, 0), velocity=Vec3(2, 0, 0), mass=2.0, radius=0.5, restitution=0.7))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec3(2, 12, 0), velocity=Vec3(-1, 0, 0), mass=1.0, radius=0.5, restitution=0.8))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec3(0, -0.5, 0), velocity=Vec3(0, 0, 0), mass=0.0, radius=0.5, is_static=True))

    # Fixed timestep for stable physics
    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0
    max_frame_time = 0.25
    accumulator = 0.0

    last_time = time.perf_counter()
    sim_time = 0.0

    print("Starting simulation. Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
    try:
        while True:
            now = time.perf_counter()
            frame_time = now - last_time
            last_time = now

            # Clamp frame time to avoid spiral of death after pauses
            frame_time = min(frame_time, max_frame_time)
            accumulator += frame_time

            while accumulator >= fixed_dt:
                world.step(fixed_dt)

                )

import math
import pygame
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List

# -----------------------------
# Vector utilities
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class Vec2:
    x: float
    y: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float): return Vec2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    def __rmul__(self, scalar: float): return self.__mul__(scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar: float): return Vec2(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y

    def length(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        if l == 0:
            return Vec2(0, 0)
        return self / l

    def perp(self):
        return Vec2(-self.y, self.x)


def rotate(v: Vec2, angle: float) -> Vec2:
    c = math.cos(angle)
    s = math.sin(angle)
    return Vec2(v.x * c - v.y * s, v.x * s + v.y * c)


# -----------------------------
# Rigid body
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    pos: Vec2
    vel: Vec2
    angle: float
    ang_vel: float
    mass: float
    width: float
    height: float
    restitution: float = 0.35

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.inv_mass = 0.0 if self.mass <= 0 else 1.0 / self.mass
        # Rectangle moment of inertia
        if self.mass <= 0:
            self.inv_inertia = 0.0
        else:
            inertia = (self.mass * (self.width ** 2 + self.height ** 2)) / 12.0
            self.inv_inertia = 1.0 / inertia

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse: Vec2, contact_vec: Vec2):
        self.vel = self.vel + impulse * self.inv_mass
        self.ang_vel += contact_vec.x * impulse.y - contact_vec.y * impulse.x
        self.ang_vel *= self.inv_inertia

    def corners(self) -> List[Vec2]:
        hw = self.width / 2
        hh = self.height / 2
        local = [
            Vec2(-hw, -hh), Vec2(hw, -hh),
            Vec2(hw, hh), Vec2(-hw, hh)
        ]
        return [self.pos + rotate(c, self.angle) for c in local]


# -----------------------------
# Physics world
# -----------------------------
class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.gravity = Vec2(0, 900.0)  # pixels/s^2
        self.bodies: List[RigidBody] = []

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate forces
        for b in self.bodies:
            if b.inv_mass == 0:
                continue
            b.vel = b.vel + self.gravity * dt
            b.pos = b.pos + b.vel * dt
            b.angle += b.ang_vel * dt

        # Collisions with world bounds
        for b in self.bodies:
            self.resolve_bounds(b)

        # Pairwise collisions (simple O(n^2) demo)
        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                self.resolve_body_collision(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])

    def resolve_bounds(self, b: RigidBody):
        # Approximate using AABB of rotated box
        corners = b.corners()
        min_x = min(p.x for p in corners)
        max_x = max(p.x for p in corners)
        min_y = min(p.y for p in corners)
        max_y = max(p.y for p in corners)

        # Left/right
        if min_x < 0:
            b.pos.x += -min_x
            b.vel.x *= -b.restitution
            b.ang_vel *= 0.98
        elif max_x > self.width:
            b.pos.x -= (max_x - self.width)
            b.vel.x *= -b.restitution
            b.ang_vel *= 0.98

        # Top/bottom
        if min_y < 0:
            b.pos.y += -min_y
            b.vel.y *= -b.restitution
            b.ang_vel *= 0.98
        elif max_y > self.height:
            b.pos.y -= (max_y - self.height)
            b.vel.y *= -b.restitution
            b.ang_vel *= 0.98

    def resolve_body_collision(self, a: RigidBody, b: RigidBody):
        # Very simple collision approximation: circle-like based on half-diagonal
        ra = math.sqrt((a.width * 0.5) ** 2 + (a.height * 0.5) ** 2)
        rb = math.sqrt((b.width * 0.5) ** 2 + (b.height * 0.5) ** 2)

        delta = b.pos - a.pos
        dist = delta.length()
        min_dist = ra + rb

        if dist >= min_dist or dist == 0:
            return

        normal = delta / dist
        penetration = min_dist - dist

        # Positional correction
        total_inv_mass = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
        if total_inv_mass == 0:
            return

        correction = normal * (penetration / total_inv_mass * 0.8)
        if a.inv_mass > 0:
            a.pos = a.pos - correction * a.inv_mass
        if b.inv_mass > 0:
            b.pos = b.pos + correction * b.inv_mass

        # Relative velocity
        rv = b.vel - a.vel
        vel_along_normal = rv.dot(normal)

        # Do not resolve if separating
        if vel_along_normal > 0:
            return

        e = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)

        j = -(1 + e) * vel_along_normal
        j /= total_inv_mass

        impulse = normal * j
        if a.inv_mass > 0:
            a.vel = a.vel - impulse * a.inv_mass
        if b.inv_mass > 0:
            b.vel = b.vel + impulse * b.inv_mass


# -----------------------------
# Rendering
# -----------------------------
def draw_body(screen, body: RigidBody):
    pts = [(p.x, p.y) for p in body.corners()]
    pygame.draw.polygon(screen, (80, 180, 255), pts, width=2)
    # draw center
    pygame.draw.circle(screen, (255, 200, 80), (int(body.pos.x), int(body.pos.y)), 3)


# -----------------------------
# Main loop with fixed timestep
# -----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    W, H = 1000, 700
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((W, H))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Real-Time Rigid Body Physics Simulation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    world = PhysicsWorld(W, H)

    # Static floor-like body could be added by making mass=0, but bounds already act as walls
    for i in range(8):
        world.add_body(
            RigidBody(
                pos=Vec2(200 + i * 70, 100 + i * 20),
                vel=Vec2(50 - i * 10, 0),
                angle=0.2 * i,
                ang_vel=1.0 - i * 0.1,
                mass=2.0,
                width=50,
                height=30,
                restitution=0.4
            )
        )

    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0  # physics at 120 Hz
    accumulator = 0.0
    max_frame_time = 0.25   # frame-rate constraint: clamp huge dt spikes

    running = True
    while running:
        frame_dt = clock.tick(60) / 1000.0  # render capped at 60 FPS
        frame_dt = min(frame_dt, max_frame_time)
        accumulator += frame_dt

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_SPACE:
                # spawn a new box
                world.add_body(
                    RigidBody(
                        pos=Vec2(W / 2, 50),
                        vel=Vec2(120 - 240 * (pygame.time.get_ticks() % 2), 0),
                        angle=0.0,
                        ang_vel=2.0,
                        mass=2.0,
                        width=40,
                        height=40,
                        restitution=0.45
                    )
                )

        # Fixed timestep update loop
        while accumulator >= fixed_dt:
            world.step(fixed_dt)
            accumulator -= fixed_dt

        # Render
        screen.fill((20, 20, 30))
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (200, 200, 200), (0, 0, W, H), 2)

        for body in world.bodies:
            draw_body(screen, body)

        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 24)
        txt = font.render("SPACE: spawn box | Fixed timestep physics | Rigid bodies", True, (230, 230, 230))
        screen.blit(txt, (15, 15))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import time
import math
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Optional

# ----------------------------
# Basic vector math
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Vec3:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    def __mul__(self, s: float): return Vec3(self.x * s, self.y * s, self.z * s)
    def __rmul__(self, s: float): return self.__mul__(s)
    def __truediv__(self, s: float): return Vec3(self.x / s, self.y / s, self.z / s)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z

    def length(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(self.dot(self))

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        if l == 0:
            return Vec3(0, 0, 0)
        return self / l


# ----------------------------
# Quaternion for orientation
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Quat:
    w: float
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float

    def __mul__(self, other):
        # Quaternion multiplication
        return Quat(
            self.w * other.w - self.x * other.x - self.y * other.y - self.z * other.z,
            self.w * other.x + self.x * other.w + self.y * other.z - self.z * other.y,
            self.w * other.y - self.x * other.z + self.y * other.w + self.z * other.x,
            self.w * other.z + self.x * other.y - self.y * other.x + self.z * other.w,
        )

    def normalized(self):
        l = math.sqrt(self.w*self.w + self.x*self.x + self.y*self.y + self.z*self.z)
        if l == 0:
            return Quat(1, 0, 0, 0)
        return Quat(self.w/l, self.x/l, self.y/l, self.z/l)

    @staticmethod
    def from_angular_velocity(omega: Vec3):
        # Quaternion derivative helper as pure quaternion
        return Quat(0, omega.x, omega.y, omega.z)


# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    position: Vec3
    velocity: Vec3
    orientation: Quat
    angular_velocity: Vec3
    mass: float
    radius: float
    restitution: float = 0.5
    is_static: bool = False

    @property
    def inv_mass(self) -> float:
        if self.is_static or self.mass <= 0:
            return 0.0
        return 1.0 / self.mass

    def apply_force(self, force: Vec3, dt: float):
        if self.is_static:
            return
        accel = force * self.inv_mass
        self.velocity = self.velocity + accel * dt

    def integrate(self, dt: float):
        if self.is_static:
            return

        # Semi-implicit Euler
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt

        # Orientation update from angular velocity
        omega = self.angular_velocity
        dq = Quat(0, omega.x, omega.y, omega.z) * self.orientation
        self.orientation = Quat(
            self.orientation.w + 0.5 * dq.w * dt,
            self.orientation.x + 0.5 * dq.x * dt,
            self.orientation.y + 0.5 * dq.y * dt,
            self.orientation.z + 0.5 * dq.z * dt,
        ).normalized()


# ----------------------------
# Collision with plane y = 0
# ----------------------------

def resolve_sphere_plane(body: RigidBody, plane_y: float = 0.0):
    if body.is_static:
        return

    penetration = (body.radius + plane_y) - body.position.y
    if penetration > 0:
        # Positional correction
        body.position.y += penetration

        # Velocity response
        if body.velocity.y < 0:
            body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.restitution

            # Simple friction
            friction = 0.98
            body.velocity.x *= friction
            body.velocity.z *= friction


# ----------------------------
# Physics world
# ----------------------------

class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self, gravity=Vec3(0, -9.81, 0)):
        self.gravity = gravity
        self.bodies: List[RigidBody] = []

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        for body in self.bodies:
            if not body.is_static:
                body.apply_force(self.gravity * body.mass, dt)

        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate(dt)
            resolve_sphere_plane(body, plane_y=0.0)


# ----------------------------
# Real-time loop with frame cap
# ----------------------------

def run_simulation():
    world = PhysicsWorld()

    # Ground plane is implicit at y = 0
    ball = RigidBody(
        position=Vec3(0, 5, 0),
        velocity=Vec3(2, 0, 0),
        orientation=Quat(1, 0, 0, 0),
        angular_velocity=Vec3(0, 0, 0),
        mass=1.0,
        radius=0.5,
        restitution=0.8,
        is_static=False
    )
    world.add_body(ball)

    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0   # physics at 120 Hz
    max_frame_dt = 1.0 / 20.0 # avoid spiral of death
    frame_cap = 60.0         # render/update cap
    frame_dt_target = 1.0 / frame_cap

    accumulator = 0.0
    last_time = time.perf_counter()

    print("Starting simulation. Ctrl+C to stop.")

    try:
        while True:
            now = time.perf_counter()
            frame_dt = now - last_time
            last_time = now

            # Clamp huge pauses
            frame_dt = min(frame_dt, max_frame_dt)
            accumulator += frame_dt

            # Fixed-step physics
            while accumulator >= fixed_dt:
                world.step(fixed_dt)
                accumulator -= fixed_dt

            # "Render" / debug output
            b = world.bodies[0]
            print(
                f"pos=({b.position.x:.2f}, {b.position.y:.2f}, {b.position.z:.2f}) "
                f"vel=({b.velocity.x:.2f}, {b.velocity.y:.2f}, {b.velocity.z:.2f})"
            )

            # Frame-rate cap
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - now
            sleep_time = frame_dt_target - elapsed
            if sleep_time > 0:
                time.sleep(sleep_time)

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nSimulation stopped.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_simulation()

## Python example: real-time 2D rigid body simulation

```python
import math
import time
import random
import pygame

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 1200, 800
TARGET_FPS = 60
FIXED_DT = 1.0 / 120.0   # physics update rate
MAX_FRAME_TIME = 0.25    # clamp to avoid spiral of death

GRAVITY = (0.0, 900.0)
RESTITUTION = 0.7
LINEAR_DAMPING = 0.999
POSITION_SLOP = 0.01
POSITION_CORRECTION_PERCENT = 0.8

# ----------------------------
# Vector helpers
# ----------------------------
def v_add(a, b): return (a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1])
def v_sub(a, b): return (a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1])
def v_mul(a, s): return (a[0] * s, a[1] * s)
def v_dot(a, b): return a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]
def v_len(a): return math.sqrt(a[0] * a[0] + a[1] * a[1])
def v_norm(a):
    l = v_len(a)
    if l == 0:
        return (0.0, 0.0)
    return (a[0] / l, a[1] / l)

# ----------------------------
# Rigid body (circle)
# ----------------------------
class Body:
    def __init__(self, x, y, radius, mass, color):
        self.pos = [x, y]
        self.vel = [0.0, 0.0]
        self.radius = radius
        self.mass = mass
        self.inv_mass = 0.0 if mass <= 0 else 1.0 / mass
        self.color = color

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.vel[0] += impulse[0] * self.inv_mass
        self.vel[1] += impulse[1] * self.inv_mass

    def integrate_forces(self, dt):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.vel[0] += GRAVITY[0] * dt
        self.vel[1] += GRAVITY[1] * dt

    def integrate_velocity(self, dt):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.pos[0] += self.vel[0] * dt
        self.pos[1] += self.vel[1] * dt
        self.vel[0] *= LINEAR_DAMPING
        self.vel[1] *= LINEAR_DAMPING

# ----------------------------
# Collision detection & resolution
# ----------------------------
def collide_circle_circle(a, b):
    delta = v_sub(b.pos, a.pos)
    dist = v_len(delta)
    r = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist >= r or dist == 0.0:
        if dist == 0.0 and r > 0:
            # Avoid divide by zero; pick arbitrary normal
            return True, (1.0, 0.0), r
        return False, (0.0, 0.0), 0.0

    normal = v_mul(delta, 1.0 / dist)
    penetration = r - dist
    return True, normal, penetration

def resolve_collision(a, b, normal, penetration):
    # Relative velocity
    rv = v_sub(b.vel, a.vel)
    vel_along_normal = v_dot(rv, normal)

    # Don't resolve if separating
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    # Impulse scalar
    inv_mass_sum = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
    if inv_mass_sum == 0:
        return

    j = -(1.0 + RESTITUTION) * vel_along_normal
    j /= inv_mass_sum

    impulse = v_mul(normal, j)
    a.apply_impulse(v_mul(impulse, -1.0))
    b.apply_impulse(impulse)

    # Positional correction to reduce sinking/jitter
    correction_mag = max(penetration - POSITION_SLOP, 0.0) / inv_mass_sum
    correction_mag *= POSITION_CORRECTION_PERCENT
    correction = v_mul(normal, correction_mag)

    if a.inv_mass > 0:
        a.pos[0] -= correction[0] * a.inv_mass
        a.pos[1] -= correction[1] * a.inv_mass
    if b.inv_mass > 0:
        b.pos[0] += correction[0] * b.inv_mass
        b.pos[1] += correction[1] * b.inv_mass

def resolve_walls(body):
    x, y = body.pos
    r = body.radius

    if x - r < 0:
        body.pos[0] = r
        body.vel[0] = -body.vel[0] * RESTITUTION
    elif x + r > WIDTH:
        body.pos[0] = WIDTH - r
        body.vel[0] = -body.vel[0] * RESTITUTION

    if y - r < 0:
        body.pos[1] = r
        body.vel[1] = -body.vel[1] * RESTITUTION
    elif y + r > HEIGHT:
        body.pos[1] = HEIGHT - r
        body.vel[1] = -body.vel[1] * RESTITUTION

# ----------------------------
# Physics world step
# ----------------------------
def physics_step(bodies, dt):
    # Integrate forces
    for body in bodies:
        body.integrate_forces(dt)

    # Integrate velocities
    for body in bodies:
        body.integrate_velocity(dt)

    # Wall collisions
    for body in bodies:
        resolve_walls(body)

    # Body-body collisions
    n = len(bodies)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            hit, normal, penetration = collide_circle_circle(bodies[i], bodies[j])
            if hit:
                resolve_collision(bodies[i], bodies[j], normal, penetration)

# ----------------------------
# Main
# ----------------------------
def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Real-Time Rigid Body Physics Simulation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    # Create bodies
    bodies = []
    for _ in range(25):
        radius = random.randint(12, 30)
        mass = radius * radius * 0.1
        x = random.randint(radius, WIDTH - radius)
        y = random.randint(radius, HEIGHT // 2)
        color = (random.randint(80, 255), random.randint(80, 255), random.randint(80, 255))
        b = Body(x, y, radius, mass, color)
        b.vel = [random.uniform(-150, 150), random.uniform(-50, 50)]
        bodies.append(b)

    # Add a static floor-like body? Not needed; walls are handled separately.

    accumulator = 0.0
    running = True

    while running:
        frame_time = clock.tick(TARGET_FPS) / 1000.0
        frame_time = min(frame_time, MAX_FRAME_TIME)
        accumulator += frame_time

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:
                mx, my = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
                radius = random.randint(15, 35)
                mass = radius * radius * 0.1
                b = Body(mx, my, radius, mass, (255, 200, 80))
                b.vel = [random.uniform(-250, 250), random.uniform(-250, 0)]
                bodies.append(b)

        # Fixed timestep physics for stable simulation
        while accumulator >= FIXED_DT:
            physics_step(bodies, FIXED_DT)
            accumulator -= FIXED_DT

        # Render
        screen.fill((20, 20, 30))

        # Draw bodies
        for body in bodies:
            pygame.draw.circle(screen, body.color, (int(body.pos[0]), int(body.pos[1])), body.radius)

        # HUD
        font = pygame.font.SysFont(None, 24)
        text = font.render(f"Bodies: {len(bodies)} | Fixed DT: {FIXED_DT:.4f}s | FPS: {clock.get_fps():.1f}", True, (240, 240, 240))
        screen.blit(text, (12, 12))

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import time
import math

# -----------------------------
# Vector utilities
# -----------------------------
class Vec3:
    __slots__ = ("x", "y", "z")

    def __init__(self, x=0.0, y=0.0, z=0.0):
        self.x = float(x)
        self.y = float(y)
        self.z = float(z)

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    def __mul__(self, scalar): return Vec3(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar, self.z * scalar)
    def __rmul__(self, scalar): return self.__mul__(scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar): return Vec3(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar, self.z / scalar)

    def dot(self, other): return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z

    def length(self): return math.sqrt(self.dot(self))

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        return self / l if l > 1e-12 else Vec3()

    def copy(self):
        return Vec3(self.x, self.y, self.z)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Vec3({self.x:.3f}, {self.y:.3f}, {self.z:.3f})"


# -----------------------------
# Rigid body (sphere for simplicity)
# -----------------------------
class RigidBody:
    def __init__(self, position, velocity, radius, mass, restitution=0.6):
        self.position = position
        self.velocity = velocity
        self.radius = radius
        self.mass = mass
        self.inv_mass = 0.0 if mass <= 0 else 1.0 / mass
        self.restitution = restitution

        # For a sphere, angular dynamics can be added later.
        self.force = Vec3()

    def apply_force(self, f):
        self.force = self.force + f

    def integrate(self, dt, gravity):
        if self.inv_mass == 0.0:
            return

        # Forces
        self.apply_force(gravity * self.mass)

        # Semi-implicit Euler:
        # v(t+dt) = v(t) + a*dt
        # x(t+dt) = x(t) + v(t+dt)*dt
        acceleration = self.force * self.inv_mass
        self.velocity = self.velocity + acceleration * dt
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt

        # Clear forces
        self.force = Vec3()


# -----------------------------
# Collision resolution
# -----------------------------
def resolve_sphere_ground(body, ground_y=0.0):
    bottom = body.position.y - body.radius
    if bottom < ground_y:
        # Positional correction
        body.position.y = ground_y + body.radius

        # Velocity response
        if body.velocity.y < 0:
            body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.restitution

            # Simple damping to reduce endless bouncing
            body.velocity.x *= 0.98
            body.velocity.z *= 0.98


def resolve_sphere_sphere(a, b):
    delta = b.position - a.position
    dist = delta.length()
    min_dist = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist < min_dist and dist > 1e-12:
        normal = delta / dist
        penetration = min_dist - dist

        # Positional correction (split by inverse mass)
        total_inv_mass = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
        if total_inv_mass > 0:
            correction = normal * (penetration / total_inv_mass)
            if a.inv_mass > 0:
                a.position = a.position - correction * a.inv_mass
            if b.inv_mass > 0:
                b.position = b.position + correction * b.inv_mass

        # Relative velocity along normal
        rel_vel = b.velocity - a.velocity
        vel_along_normal = rel_vel.dot(normal)

        # Only resolve if bodies are moving toward each other
        if vel_along_normal < 0:
            restitution = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)
            j = -(1 + restitution) * vel_along_normal
            j /= total_inv_mass if total_inv_mass > 0 else 1.0

            impulse = normal * j
            if a.inv_mass > 0:
                a.velocity = a.velocity - impulse * a.inv_mass
            if b.inv_mass > 0:
                b.velocity = b.velocity + impulse * b.inv_mass


# -----------------------------
# Physics world
# -----------------------------
class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self, gravity=Vec3(0, -9.81, 0), fixed_dt=1.0 / 120.0):
        self.gravity = gravity
        self.fixed_dt = fixed_dt
        self.bodies = []
        self.accumulator = 0.0

    def add_body(self, body):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt):
        # Frame-rate independent stepping with accumulator
        self.accumulator += dt

        # Avoid spiral of death if frame stalls
        max_substeps = 8
        substeps = 0

        while self.accumulator >= self.fixed_dt and substeps < max_substeps:
            self._fixed_step(self.fixed_dt)
            self.accumulator -= self.fixed_dt
            substeps += 1

    def _fixed_step(self, dt):
        # Integrate
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate(dt, self.gravity)

        # Collisions: ground + pairwise sphere-sphere
        for body in self.bodies:
            resolve_sphere_ground(body, ground_y=0.0)

        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                resolve_sphere_sphere(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])


# -----------------------------
# Demo / real-time loop
# -----------------------------
def main():
    world = PhysicsWorld(fixed_dt=1.0 / 120.0)

    # Create a few spheres
    world.add_body(RigidBody(Vec3(-1.0, 6.0, 0.0), Vec3(2.0, 0.0, 0.0), radius=0.5, mass=1.0, restitution=0.7))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(Vec3( 1.0, 8.0, 0.0), Vec3(-1.5, 0.0, 0.0), radius=0.6, mass=2.0, restitution=0.5))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(Vec3( 0.0, 12.0, 0.0), Vec3(0.0, -1.0, 0.0), radius=0.4, mass=0.5, restitution=0.8))

    print("Starting simulation. Press Ctrl+C to stop.\n")

    last_time = time.perf_counter()
    sim_time = 0.0

    try:
        while True:
            now = time.perf_counter()
            frame_dt = now - last_time
            last_time = now

            # Clamp frame delta to prevent huge jumps after pauses
            frame_dt = min(frame_dt, 0.05)

            world.step(frame_dt)
            sim_time += frame_dt

            # Print state at ~60 Hz
            if int(sim_time * 60) != int((sim_time - frame_dt) * 60):
                print(f"t={sim_time:6.2f}s")
                for i, b in enumerate(world.bodies):
                    print(f"  body {i}: pos={b.position}, vel={b.velocity}")
                print()

            # Sleep a bit to reduce CPU usage in this text demo
            time.sleep(0.001)

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Simulation stopped.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

This prevents the “spiral of death” if the machine lags and physics tries to catch up forever.

# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Vec2:
    x: float
    y: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    def __mul__(self, s: float): return Vec2(self.x * s, self.y * s)
    def __rmul__(self, s: float): return self.__mul__(s)
    def __truediv__(self, s: float): return Vec2(self.x / s, self.y / s)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y

    def length(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        if l == 0:
            return Vec2(0, 0)
        return self / l

    def perp(self):
        return Vec2(-self.y, self.x)


def clamp(x, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(hi, x))


# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    position: Vec2
    velocity: Vec2
    angle: float
    angular_velocity: float
    mass: float
    radius: float  # sphere/circle for this demo
    restitution: float = 0.4
    friction: float = 0.2

    force: Vec2 = Vec2(0, 0)
    torque: float = 0.0

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.mass <= 0:
            self.inv_mass = 0.0
            self.inertia = float("inf")
            self.inv_inertia = 0.0
        else:
            self.inv_mass = 1.0 / self.mass
            # Solid disk inertia for 2D circle
            self.inertia = 0.5 * self.mass * self.radius * self.radius
            self.inv_inertia = 1.0 / self.inertia

    def apply_force(self, f: Vec2):
        self.force = self.force + f

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse: Vec2):
        self.velocity = self.velocity + impulse * self.inv_mass

    def integrate_forces(self, dt: float, gravity: Vec2):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        # F = ma, semi-implicit Euler
        acc = gravity + self.force * self.inv_mass
        self.velocity = self.velocity + acc * dt
        self.angular_velocity += self.torque * self.inv_inertia * dt

    def integrate_velocity(self, dt: float):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt
        self.angle += self.angular_velocity * dt

    def clear_forces(self):
        self.force = Vec2(0, 0)
        self.torque = 0.0


# ----------------------------
# Collision: circle-circle
# ----------------------------

def resolve_circle_circle(a: RigidBody, b: RigidBody):
    delta = b.position - a.position
    dist = delta.length()
    min_dist = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist <= 0.000001:
        # Avoid divide by zero
        normal = Vec2(1, 0)
        penetration = min_dist
    else:
        if dist >= min_dist:
            return
        normal = delta / dist
        penetration = min_dist - dist

    # Positional correction (split correction)
    percent = 0.8
    slop = 0.01
    correction_mag = max(penetration - slop, 0.0) / (a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass) * percent
    correction = normal * correction_mag

    if a.inv_mass > 0:
        a.position = a.position - correction * a.inv_mass
    if b.inv_mass > 0:
        b.position = b.position + correction * b.inv_mass

    # Relative velocity
    rv = b.velocity - a.velocity
    vel_along_normal = rv.dot(normal)

    # Do not resolve if separating
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    e = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)

    j = -(1 + e) * vel_along_normal
    inv_mass_sum = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
    if inv_mass_sum == 0:
        return
    j /= inv_mass_sum

    impulse = normal * j
    if a.inv_mass > 0:
        a.velocity = a.velocity - impulse * a.inv_mass
    if b.inv_mass > 0:
        b.velocity = b.velocity + impulse * b.inv_mass


# ----------------------------
# Collision: ground plane
# ----------------------------

def resolve_ground(body: RigidBody, ground_y: float):
    # Ground is a horizontal line at y = ground_y, bodies rest above it
    if body.position.y + body.radius > ground_y:
        penetration = (body.position.y + body.radius) - ground_y

        # Push body out of ground
        body.position.y -= penetration

        # Reflect velocity if moving downward
        if body.velocity.y > 0:
            body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.restitution
            body.velocity.x *= (1.0 - body.friction)


# ----------------------------
# Physics world
# ----------------------------

class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self, gravity=Vec2(0, 900)):
        self.gravity = gravity
        self.bodies: List[RigidBody] = []
        self.ground_y = 560

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate forces
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate_forces(dt, self.gravity)

        # Integrate velocities
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate_velocity(dt)

        # Collisions
        for body in self.bodies:
            resolve_ground(body, self.ground_y)

        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                resolve_circle_circle(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])

        # Clear forces
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.clear_forces()


# ----------------------------
# Main demo with frame-rate constraints
# ----------------------------

def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((900, 600))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Real-Time Rigid Body Physics Demo")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(200, 100), velocity=Vec2(120, 0), angle=0,

    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(300, 50), velocity=Vec2(-80, 0), angle=0,

    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(450, 150), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), angle=0,
                             angular_velocity=0, mass=3.0, radius=30, restitution=0.4))

    # Fixed timestep settings
    FIXED_DT = 1.0 / 120.0   # physics update rate
    MAX_FRAME_DT = 0.25      # clamp huge frame spikes
    accumulator = 0.0

    running = True
    while running:
        frame_dt = clock.tick(60) / 1000.0  # render at ~60 FPS
        frame_dt = min(frame_dt, MAX_FRAME_DT)
        accumulator += frame_dt

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:

        # Example input: click to spawn bodies
        if pygame.mouse.get_pressed()[0]:

            ))

            world.step(FIXED_DT)
            accumulator -= FIXED_DT
            substeps += 1

import math
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass

# ----------------------------
# Vector utilities
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Vec2:
    x: float
    y: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec2(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float): return Vec2(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    def __rmul__(self, scalar: float): return self.__mul__(scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar: float): return Vec2(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y

    def length(self) -> float:
        return math.sqrt(self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y)

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        if l == 0:
            return Vec2(0, 0)
        return self / l


# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    position: Vec2
    velocity: Vec2
    radius: float
    mass: float
    restitution: float = 0.6

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.inv_mass = 0.0 if self.mass <= 0 else 1.0 / self.mass

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse: Vec2):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.velocity = self.velocity + impulse * self.inv_mass

    def integrate(self, dt: float, gravity: Vec2):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.velocity = self.velocity + gravity * dt
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt


# ----------------------------
# Collision resolution
# ----------------------------

def resolve_circle_collision(a: RigidBody, b: RigidBody):
    delta = b.position - a.position
    dist = delta.length()
    min_dist = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist == 0:
        # Prevent division by zero
        normal = Vec2(1, 0)
        penetration = min_dist
    else:
        if dist >= min_dist:
            return
        normal = delta / dist
        penetration = min_dist - dist

    # Positional correction (to prevent sinking)
    percent = 0.8  # correction strength
    slop = 0.01
    inv_mass_sum = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass
    if inv_mass_sum > 0:
        correction_mag = max(penetration - slop, 0.0) / inv_mass_sum * percent
        correction = normal * correction_mag
        if a.inv_mass > 0:
            a.position = a.position - correction * a.inv_mass
        if b.inv_mass > 0:
            b.position = b.position + correction * b.inv_mass

    # Relative velocity
    rv = b.velocity - a.velocity
    vel_along_normal = rv.dot(normal)

    # Do not resolve if separating
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    restitution = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)

    j = -(1 + restitution) * vel_along_normal
    if inv_mass_sum > 0:
        j /= inv_mass_sum
    else:
        return

    impulse = normal * j
    a.apply_impulse(-impulse)
    b.apply_impulse(impulse)


# ----------------------------
# World
# ----------------------------

class PhysicsWorld:
    def __init__(self):
        self.bodies = []
        self.gravity = Vec2(0, 9.81 * 100)  # pixels/s^2

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate forces
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate(dt, self.gravity)

        # Collision detection + resolution
        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                resolve_circle_collision(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])

        # Simple boundary collisions
        self.handle_bounds(800, 600)

    def handle_bounds(self, width: int, height: int):
        for body in self.bodies:
            if body.inv_mass == 0:
                continue

            # Left/right
            if body.position.x - body.radius < 0:
                body.position.x = body.radius
                body.velocity.x *= -body.restitution
            elif body.position.x + body.radius > width:
                body.position.x = width - body.radius
                body.velocity.x *= -body.restitution

            # Top/bottom
            if body.position.y - body.radius < 0:
                body.position.y = body.radius
                body.velocity.y *= -body.restitution
            elif body.position.y + body.radius > height:
                body.position.y = height - body.radius
                body.velocity.y *= -body.restitution


# ----------------------------
# Fixed timestep simulation loop
# ----------------------------

def run_simulation():
    world = PhysicsWorld()

    # Example bodies
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(200, 100), velocity=Vec2(120, 0), radius=20, mass=2.0))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(260, 100), velocity=Vec2(-40, 0), radius=25, mass=3.0))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(400, 50), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), radius=30, mass=5.0))
    world.add_body(RigidBody(position=Vec2(400, 580), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), radius=40, mass=0.0))  # static body

    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0  # 120 Hz physics
    accumulator = 0.0
    last_time = time.perf_counter()

    while True:
        now = time.perf_counter()
        frame_dt = now - last_time
        last_time = now

        # Clamp to avoid spiral of death on frame drops
        frame_dt = min(frame_dt, 0.25)
        accumulator += frame_dt

        while accumulator >= fixed_dt:
            world.step(fixed_dt)
            accumulator -= fixed_dt

        # "Render" to console for demo purposes

import math

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional

Vec2 = pygame.math.Vector2

# -----------------------------
# Utility
# -----------------------------

def clamp(x, a, b):
    return max(a, min(b, x))

def rotate(v: Vec2, angle: float) -> Vec2:
    c = math.cos(angle)
    s = math.sin(angle)
    return Vec2(v.x * c - v.y * s, v.x * s + v.y * c)

def cross2(a: Vec2, b: Vec2) -> float:
    return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x

def cross_sv(s: float, v: Vec2) -> Vec2:
    # scalar x vector
    return Vec2(-s * v.y, s * v.x)

# -----------------------------
# Rigid Body
# -----------------------------

@dataclass
class Body:
    position: Vec2
    velocity: Vec2
    angle: float
    angular_velocity: float
    mass: float
    restitution: float = 0.3
    friction: float = 0.4
    is_static: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.is_static or self.mass <= 0:
            self.inv_mass = 0.0
            self.inv_inertia = 0.0
        else:
            self.inv_mass = 1.0 / self.mass
            self.inv_inertia = 1.0 / self.inertia()

    def inertia(self) -> float:
        return 1.0  # overridden by shapes

    def apply_impulse(self, impulse: Vec2, contact_vec: Vec2):
        if self.inv_mass == 0:
            return
        self.velocity += impulse * self.inv_mass
        self.angular_velocity += self.inv_inertia * cross2(contact_vec, impulse)

# -----------------------------
# Shapes
# -----------------------------

@dataclass
class Circle(Body):
    radius: float = 10.0

    def inertia(self) -> float:
        return 0.5 * self.mass * self.radius * self.radius

@dataclass
class Box(Body):
    half_extents: Vec2 = Vec2(20, 20)

    def inertia(self) -> float:
        w = self.half_extents.x * 2
        h = self.half_extents.y * 2
        return (1.0 / 12.0) * self.mass * (w * w + h * h)

# -----------------------------
# Collision Manifold
# -----------------------------

@dataclass
class Manifold:
    a: Body
    b: Body
    normal: Vec2
    penetration: float
    contacts: List[Vec2]

# -----------------------------
# Collision Detection
# -----------------------------

def circle_circle(a: Circle, b: Circle) -> Optional[Manifold]:
    n = b.position - a.position
    dist2 = n.length_squared()
    r = a.radius + b.radius
    if dist2 >= r * r:
        return None

    dist = math.sqrt(dist2) if dist2 > 0 else 0.0
    normal = n / dist if dist > 0 else Vec2(1, 0)
    penetration = r - dist
    contact = a.position + normal * (a.radius - penetration * 0.5)
    return Manifold(a, b, normal, penetration, [contact])

def box_box(a: Box, b: Box) -> Optional[Manifold]:
    # Axis-aligned boxes with rotation ignored for simplicity in collision.
    # Good enough for a real-time baseline demo.
    a_min = a.position - a.half_extents
    a_max = a.position + a.half_extents
    b_min = b.position - b.half_extents
    b_max = b.position + b.half_extents

    overlap_x = min(a_max.x, b_max.x) - max(a_min.x, b_min.x)
    overlap_y = min(a_max.y, b_max.y) - max(a_min.y, b_min.y)

    if overlap_x <= 0 or overlap_y <= 0:
        return None

    if overlap_x < overlap_y:
        normal = Vec2(1, 0) if a.position.x < b.position.x else Vec2(-1, 0)
        penetration = overlap_x
    else:
        normal = Vec2(0, 1) if a.position.y < b.position.y else Vec2(0, -1)
        penetration = overlap_y

    contact = (a.position + b.position) * 0.5
    return Manifold(a, b, normal, penetration, [contact])

def circle_box(circle: Circle, box: Box) -> Optional[Manifold]:
    # Treat box as AABB for collision
    box_min = box.position - box.half_extents
    box_max = box.position + box.half_extents

    closest = Vec2(
        clamp(circle.position.x, box_min.x, box_max.x),
        clamp(circle.position.y, box_min.y, box_max.y),
    )

    delta = circle.position - closest
    dist2 = delta.length_squared()
    if dist2 > circle.radius * circle.radius:
        return None

    dist = math.sqrt(dist2) if dist2 > 0 else 0.0
    if dist > 0:
        normal = delta / dist
    else:
        # Circle center inside box; choose nearest axis
        dx = min(abs(circle.position.x - box_min.x), abs(box_max.x - circle.position.x))
        dy = min(abs(circle.position.y - box_min.y), abs(box_max.y - circle.position.y))
        if dx < dy:
            normal = Vec2(1, 0) if circle.position.x > box.position.x else Vec2(-1, 0)
        else:
            normal = Vec2(0, 1) if circle.position.y > box.position.y else Vec2(0, -1)

    penetration = circle.radius - dist if dist > 0 else circle.radius
    return Manifold(circle, box, normal, penetration, [closest])

def collide(a: Body, b: Body) -> Optional[Manifold]:
    if isinstance(a, Circle) and isinstance(b, Circle):
        return circle_circle(a, b)
    if isinstance(a, Box) and isinstance(b, Box):
        return box_box(a, b)
    if isinstance(a, Circle) and isinstance(b, Box):
        return circle_box(a, b)
    if isinstance(a, Box) and isinstance(b, Circle):
        m = circle_box(b, a)
        if m:
            return Manifold(a, b, -m.normal, m.penetration, m.contacts)
    return None

# -----------------------------
# Physics Resolution
# -----------------------------

def resolve_collision(m: Manifold):
    a, b = m.a, m.b
    if a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass == 0:
        return

    # Positional correction to reduce sinking
    percent = 0.8
    slop = 0.01
    correction_mag = max(m.penetration - slop, 0.0) / (a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass) * percent
    correction = correction_mag * m.normal
    if a.inv_mass > 0:
        a.position -= correction * a.inv_mass
    if b.inv_mass > 0:
        b.position += correction * b.inv_mass

    for contact in m.contacts:
        ra = contact - a.position
        rb = contact - b.position

        va = a.velocity + cross_sv(a.angular_velocity, ra)
        vb = b.velocity + cross_sv(b.angular_velocity, rb)
        rv = vb - va

        vel_along_normal = rv.dot(m.normal)
        if vel_along_normal > 0:
            continue

        e = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)

        ra_cn = cross2(ra, m.normal)
        rb_cn = cross2(rb, m.normal)
        inv_mass_sum = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass + (ra_cn * ra_cn) * a.inv_inertia + (rb_cn * rb_cn) * b.inv_inertia

        j = -(1 + e) * vel_along_normal
        j /= inv_mass_sum
        j /= max(len(m.contacts), 1)

        impulse = j * m.normal
        a.apply_impulse(-impulse, ra)
        b.apply_impulse(impulse, rb)

        # Friction
        va = a.velocity + cross_sv(a.angular_velocity, ra)
        vb = b.velocity + cross_sv(b.angular_velocity, rb)
        rv = vb - va

        tangent = rv - rv.dot(m.normal) * m.normal
        if tangent.length_squared() > 1e-12:
            tangent = tangent.normalize()

        jt = -rv.dot(tangent)
        jt /= inv_mass_sum
        jt /= max(len(m.contacts), 1)

        mu = math.sqrt(a.friction * b.friction)
        friction_impulse = Vec2(0, 0)
        if abs(jt) < j * mu:
            friction_impulse = jt * tangent
        else:
            friction_impulse = -j * mu * tangent

        a.apply_impulse(-friction_impulse, ra)
        b.apply_impulse(friction_impulse, rb)

# -----------------------------
# World / Simulation
# -----------------------------

class World:
    def __init__(self, gravity=Vec2(0, 900)):
        self.gravity = gravity
        self.bodies: List[Body] = []

    def add(self, body: Body):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate
        for body in self.bodies:
            if body.inv_mass == 0:
                continue
            body.velocity += self.gravity * dt
            body.position += body.velocity * dt
            body.angle += body.angular_velocity * dt

        # Collisions
        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                m = collide(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])
                if m:
                    resolve_collision(m)

# -----------------------------
# Rendering
# -----------------------------

def draw_body(screen, body: Body):
    if isinstance(body, Circle):
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (220, 220, 255), body.position, int(body.radius), 2)
        # orientation marker
        end = body.position + Vec2(math.cos(body.angle), math.sin(body.angle)) * body.radius
        pygame.draw.line(screen, (255, 100, 100), body.position, end, 2)

    elif isinstance(body, Box):
        hx, hy = body.half_extents
        corners = [
            Vec2(-hx, -hy), Vec2(hx, -hy), Vec2(hx, hy), Vec2(-hx, hy)
        ]
        pts = [body.position + rotate(c, body.angle) for c in corners]
        pygame.draw.polygon(screen, (200, 255, 200), pts, 2)

# -----------------------------
# Main
# -----------------------------

def main():
    pygame.init()
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((1280, 720))
    pygame.display.set_caption("Real-Time Rigid Body Physics Simulation")
    clock = pygame.time.Clock()

    world = World()

    # Boundaries
    world.add(Box(position=Vec2(640, 700), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), angle=0, angular_velocity=0,
                  mass=0, is_static=True, half_extents=Vec2(700, 20), restitution=0.2))
    world.add(Box(position=Vec2(20, 360), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), angle=0, angular_velocity=0,
                  mass=0, is_static=True, half_extents=Vec2(20, 360), restitution=0.2))
    world.add(Box(position=Vec2(1260, 360), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), angle=0, angular_velocity=0,
                  mass=0, is_static=True, half_extents=Vec2(20, 360), restitution=0.2))
    world.add(Box(position=Vec2(640, 20), velocity=Vec2(0, 0), angle=0, angular_velocity=0,
                  mass=0, is_static=True, half_extents=Vec2(700, 20), restitution=0.2))

    # Dynamic bodies
    for i in range(6):
        world.add(Circle(
            position=Vec2(250 + i * 70, 100),
            velocity=Vec2(30 - i * 5, 0),
            angle=0,
            angular_velocity=0,
            mass=2.0,
            radius=18,
            restitution=0.5,
            friction=0.5
        ))

    for i in range(4):
        world.add(Box(
            position=Vec2(800 + i * 60, 120),
            velocity=Vec2(-20, 0),
            angle=0.1 * i,
            angular_velocity=0.5,
            mass=4.0,
            half_extents=Vec2(25, 25),
            restitution=0.3,
            friction=0.6
        ))

    # Fixed timestep for frame-rate independence
    fixed_dt = 1.0 / 120.0
    accumulator = 0.0
    max_frame_dt = 0.25  # avoid spiral of death

    running = True
    while running:
        frame_dt = clock.tick(60) / 1000.0
        frame_dt = min(frame_dt, max_frame_dt)
        accumulator += frame_dt

        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:
                # Spawn a new circle at mouse position
                pos = Vec2(pygame.mouse.get_pos())
                world.add(Circle(
                    position=pos,
                    velocity=Vec2(0, -100),
                    angle=0,
                    angular_velocity=0,
                    mass=1.5,
                    radius=15,
                    restitution=0.6,
                    friction=0.4
                ))

        while accumulator >= fixed_dt:
            world.step(fixed_dt)
            accumulator -= fixed_dt

        screen.fill((20, 20, 30))
        for body in world.bodies:
            draw_body(screen, body)

        pygame.display.flip()

    pygame.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from math import sqrt
from typing import List, Optional

# ----------------------------
# Basic vector math
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class Vec3:
    x: float
    y: float
    z: float = 0.0

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar, self.z * scalar)
    def __rmul__(self, scalar: float): return self.__mul__(scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar, self.z / scalar)

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return self.x * other.x + self.y * other.y + self.z * other.z

    def length(self) -> float:
        return sqrt(self.dot(self))

    def normalized(self):
        l = self.length()
        return self / l if l > 1e-8 else Vec3(0, 0, 0)


# ----------------------------
# Rigid body
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class RigidBody:
    position: Vec3
    velocity: Vec3
    mass: float
    radius: float = 0.5  # simple sphere collider
    force_accum: Vec3 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vec3(0, 0, 0))
    restitution: float = 0.5
    is_static: bool = False

    @property
    def inv_mass(self) -> float:
        if self.is_static or self.mass <= 0:
            return 0.0
        return 1.0 / self.mass

    def apply_force(self, force: Vec3):
        if not self.is_static:
            self.force_accum = self.force_accum + force

    def integrate(self, dt: float, gravity: Vec3):
        if self.is_static:
            return

        # Force -> acceleration
        acceleration = gravity + self.force_accum * self.inv_mass

        # Semi-implicit Euler
        self.velocity = self.velocity + acceleration * dt
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt

        # Clear forces
        self.force_accum = Vec3(0, 0, 0)


# ----------------------------
# Collision: sphere vs ground plane
# ----------------------------

def resolve_ground_collision(body: RigidBody, ground_y: float = 0.0):
    if body.is_static:
        return

    penetration = (ground_y + body.radius) - body.position.y
    if penetration > 0:
        # Positional correction
        body.position.y += penetration

        # Velocity response
        if body.velocity.y < 0:
            body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * body.restitution

            # Simple friction approximation
            body.velocity.x *= 0.98
            body.velocity.z *= 0.98


# ----------------------------
# Collision: sphere vs sphere
# ----------------------------

def resolve_sphere_collision(a: RigidBody, b: RigidBody):
    delta = b.position - a.position
    dist = delta.length()
    min_dist = a.radius + b.radius

    if dist <= 1e-8 or dist >= min_dist:
        return

    normal = delta / dist
    penetration = min_dist - dist
    inv_mass_sum = a.inv_mass + b.inv_mass

    if inv_mass_sum <= 0:
        return

    # Positional correction
    correction = normal * (penetration / inv_mass_sum)
    if not a.is_static:
        a.position = a.position - correction * a.inv_mass
    if not b.is_static:
        b.position = b.position + correction * b.inv_mass

    # Relative velocity
    rel_vel = b.velocity - a.velocity
    vel_along_normal = rel_vel.dot(normal)

    # If separating, no impulse
    if vel_along_normal > 0:
        return

    restitution = min(a.restitution, b.restitution)
    j = -(1 + restitution) * vel_along_normal
    j /= inv_mass_sum

    impulse = normal * j
    if not a.is_static:
        a.velocity = a.velocity - impulse * a.inv_mass
    if not b.is_static:
        b.velocity = b.velocity + impulse * b.inv_mass


# ----------------------------
# Physics world
# ----------------------------

@dataclass
class PhysicsWorld:
    bodies: List[RigidBody] = field(default_factory=list)
    gravity: Vec3 = Vec3(0, -9.81, 0)
    fixed_dt: float = 1.0 / 120.0
    max_substeps: int = 8
    max_accumulator: float = 0.25
    accumulator: float = 0.0

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Clamp to avoid spiral of death on large frame spikes
        self.accumulator = min(self.accumulator + dt, self.max_accumulator)

        substeps = 0
        while self.accumulator >= self.fixed_dt and substeps < self.max_substeps:
            self._physics_step(self.fixed_dt)
            self.accumulator -= self.fixed_dt
            substeps += 1

    def _physics_step(self, dt: float):
        # Integrate
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.integrate(dt, self.gravity)

        # Collisions
        for body in self.bodies:
            resolve_ground_collision(body, ground_y=0.0)

        n = len(self.bodies)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                resolve_sphere_collision(self.bodies[i], self.bodies[j])


# ----------------------------
# Example usage
# ----------------------------

    y: float
    z: float

    def __add__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)
    def __sub__(self, other): return Vec3(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)
    def __mul__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar, self.z * scalar)
    def __truediv__(self, scalar: float): return Vec3(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar, self.z / scalar)

@dataclass
class Quat:

    x: float
    y: float
    z: float

    def normalized(self):

        if l <= 1e-8:

            self.w*other.z + self.x*other.y - self.y*other.x + self.z*other.w,

    angular_velocity: Vec3 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    force_accum: Vec3 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    torque_accum: Vec3 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    radius: float = 0.5  # simple sphere collider

    @property
    def inv_mass(self) -> float:
        return 0.0 if self.mass <= 0 else 1.0 / self.mass

    def apply_force(self, force: Vec3):
        self.force_accum = self.force_accum + force

    def apply_torque(self, torque: Vec3):
        self.torque_accum = self.torque_accum + torque

    def clear_accumulators(self):
        self.force_accum = Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        self.torque_accum = Vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

    def integrate(self, dt: float, gravity: Vec3):
        if self.mass <= 0:
            return  # static body

        # Linear motion (semi-implicit Euler)
        acceleration = gravity + (self.force_accum * self.inv_mass)
        self.velocity = self.velocity + acceleration * dt
        self.position = self.position + self.velocity * dt

        # Angular motion (very simplified)
        angular_acceleration = self.torque_accum * self.inv_mass
        self.angular_velocity = self.angular_velocity + angular_acceleration * dt

        dq = Quat.from_angular_velocity(self.angular_velocity, dt)
        self.orientation = (self.orientation + dq * self.orientation).normalized()

        self.clear_accumulators()

    def __add_quat(self, q1: Quat, q2: Quat) -> Quat:
        return Quat(q1.w + q2.w, q1.x + q2.x, q1.y + q2.y, q1.z + q2.z)


# -----------------------------
# Physics world
# -----------------------------
@dataclass
class PhysicsWorld:
    bodies: List[RigidBody] = field(default_factory=list)
    gravity: Vec3 = field(default_factory=lambda: Vec3(0.0, -9.81, 0.0))
    ground_y: float = 0.0
    restitution: float = 0.4
    linear_damping: float = 0.999
    angular_damping: float = 0.995

    def add_body(self, body: RigidBody):
        self.bodies.append(body)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        # Apply forces and integrate
        for body in self.bodies:
            if body.mass > 0:
                body.integrate(dt, self.gravity)
                body.velocity = body.velocity * self.linear_damping
                body.angular_velocity = body.angular_velocity * self.angular_damping

                self.resolve_ground_collision(body)

    def resolve_ground_collision(self, body: RigidBody):
        # Simple sphere-ground collision
        min_y = self.ground_y + body.radius
        if body.position.y < min_y:
            body.position.y = min_y

            # Bounce if moving downward
            if body.velocity.y < 0:
                body.velocity.y = -body.velocity.y * self.restitution

                # Simple friction approximation on bounce
                body.velocity.x *= 0.85
                body.velocity.z *= 0.85

                # Dampen angular velocity on contact
                body.angular_velocity = body.angular_velocity * 0.9


# -----------------------------
# Fixed timestep real-time loop
# -----------------------------
class RealTimeSimulation:
    def __init__(self, world: PhysicsWorld, fixed_dt: float = 1.0 / 120.0, max_frame_dt: float = 0.25):
        self.world = world
        self.fixed_dt = fixed_dt
        self.max_frame_dt = max_frame_dt
        self.accumulator = 0.0
        self.last_time = time.perf_counter()

    def run(self, duration_seconds: float = 5.0):
        end_time = time.perf_counter() + duration_seconds

        while time.perf_counter() < end_time:
            now = time.perf_counter()
            frame_dt = now - self.last_time
            self.last_time = now

            # Frame-rate constraint: clamp huge dt spikes
            frame_dt = min(frame_dt, self.max_frame_dt)
            self.accumulator += frame_dt

            # Run physics at fixed timestep
            while self.accumulator >= self.fixed_dt:
                self.world.step(self.fixed_dt)
                self.accumulator -= self.fixed_dt

            self.debug_print()
            time.sleep(0.001)  # small sleep to reduce CPU usage

    def debug_print(self):
        for i, body in enumerate(self.world.bodies):
            print(
                f"Body {i}: "
                f"pos=({body.position.x:.2f}, {body.position.y:.2f}, {body.position.z:.2f}) "
                f"vel=({body.velocity.x:.2f}, {body.velocity.y:.2f}, {body.velocity.z:.2f})"
            )
        print("-" * 60)
